{{Quote|I am a Techno-service droid, not a safe deposit box.|Todo 360 to Davtokk|<ref name="Invitation Only" />}}
'''Techno-service droids''' were diminutive [[Service droid/Legends|service]] and [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droids]].

==History==
{{Quote|You'll find Cad Bane down here, sir.|Todo 360 to Davtokk|<ref name="Invitation Only" />}}
[[File:Todo360-TCW.png|thumb|left|200px|A techno-service droid in wheel-mode.]]
One techno-service droid, designated [[Todo 360/Legends|Todo 360]], was employed by the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Under the pretense of interviewing him for a job, Bane lured [[Davtokk]], a fellow [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter, to [[Keyorin]] around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to test the abilities of his new posse by pitting Davtokk against them. Bane sent his droid to guide Davtokk to the proper meeting place, though the latter refused, offering a tip for the droid's master. Later, after Davtokk had been apprehended by [[Robonino/Legends|Robonino]], [[Shahan Alama/Legends|Shahan Alama]] and [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]], the droid was at Bane's side as he emerged from the shadows and ended Davtokk's life.<ref name="Invitation Only">''[[The Clone Wars: Invitation Only]]''</ref>

Todo was later employed by Bane in his attempt to [[Raid on the Jedi Temple/Legends|steal]] a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] from the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Archives]].<ref name="Holocron Heist Book">''[[The Clone Wars: The Holocron Heist]]''</ref>

Techno-service droids had [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]] on the bottom of each foot, and were able to latch their feet together to create a single wheel.
